LAW AND MOTION 301, PLAINTIFF SAK ONKVISIT'S PETITION FOR JUDICIAL ARBITRATION AND APPOINTMENT OF ARBITRATOR IS CONTINUED TO MAY 4, 2009 TO BE HEARD WITH DEFENDANT'S MOTION. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189

LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANT PHYLLIS ANDELIN'S MOTION FOR AN ORDER APPOINTING ARBITRATOR AND FOR AN ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE RE: CONTEMPT OR ASSESSMENT OF MONETARY SANCTIONS FOR DISOBEDIENCE OF COURT ORDER. THE COURT WILL APPOINT AN ARBITRATOR PURSUANT TO CCP SECTION 1281.6. EACH PARTY SHALL SUBMIT TO THE COURT AND TO EACH OTHER, NO LATER THAN MAY 18, 2009, A LIST OF FIVE (5) PROPOSED ARBITRATORS, ALONG WITH A STATEMENT OF EACH ARBITRATOR'S QUALIFICATIONS AND RATES AND AN INDICATION WHETHER THE ARBITRATOR HAS AGREED TO SERVE IF CHOSEN BY THE COURT. THE COURT WILL NOMINATE FIVE (5) ARBITRATORS FROM THOSE LISTS, IF THE PARTIES HAVE NOT NOTIFIED THE COURT WITH 5 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THE COURT'S NOMINEES THAT THEY HAVE AGREED ON AN ARBITRATOR, THE COURT WILL APPOINT ONE OF ITS NOMINEES. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189

LAW AND MOTION 301, THE COURT NOTED THAT THESE ARE TWO CROSS MOTIONS :1) PLAINTIFF SAK ONKVISIT'S PETITION FOR JUDICIAL ARBITRATION AND APPOINTMENT OF ARBITRATOR IS A CONTINUATION FROM LAST FRIDAY'S HEARING (MAY 1, 2009). THIS IS NOT AN APPROPRIATE RELIEF AND IN ANY EVENT IS NOT TIMELY NOTICED. 2) THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING ON THE DEFENDANT PHYLLIS ANDELIN'S MOTION FOR AN ORDER APPOINTING ARBITRATOR AND FOR AN ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE REGARDING CONTEMPT OR ASSESSMENT OF MONETARY SACTIONS FOR DISOBEDIENCE OF COURT ORDER.
